title: A Weak Fly, True Striving, and Successful Believers

paragraphs.text: People worship things besides Allah without any proof or knowledge. When Allah's clear verses are recited, the disbelievers' faces show anger. They almost attack those who recite. But the Fire that Allah promised them is far worse.

Here is an example, so listen. Those you call on besides Allah could never create even a fly, even if they all worked together. If a fly stole something from them, they could not take it back. Both the seeker and the sought are weak. People have not truly valued Allah, who is Powerful and Mighty. He chooses messengers from angels and from people. He knows what is before them and after them.

O believers, bow, prostrate, worship your Lord and do good, so that you may succeed. Strive for Allah as He deserves. He chose you and put no hardship on you in religion. It is the religion of your father Abraham. Allah named you Muslims before and in this Quran. So pray, give zakah and hold firmly to Allah. He is the best protector and the best helper.

The believers have truly succeeded. They are humble in their prayer and turn away from bad talk. They give zakah and guard their private parts, except with their wives or those their right hands possess. Those who seek beyond that are transgressors. The believers keep their trusts and promises, and they carefully protect their prayers.
